topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found a notebook hidden away in the back of the closet, tucked neatly behind the winter coats. It was bound in leather, worn at the edges, and when I opened it, I realized it was a story. A story about me, or at least someone very much like me. The words were so intimate, so detailed, it was as if my partner had been watching me closely, not just for moments, but for a lifetime. I didn’t know what to think. What does it mean? Are these the thoughts they keep to themselves, maybe even from me? I just feel so... I need to understand what this all means.
